valid.open-append-evidence.json: Active open Review may append actually-considered evidence without changing workflow state.
valid.open-to-in-review.json: Open Review may enter active review and append evidence.
valid.in-review-to-awaiting.json: In-review state may wait for additional information.
valid.awaiting-to-in-review.json: Awaiting-information Review may resume and append evidence.
valid.in-review-to-completed.json: In-review Review may complete without creating a finding.
valid.open-to-cancelled.json: Open Review may be cancelled as valid workflow history.

application_invalid.completed-reopened.json: Completed Review is frozen and cannot reopen.
application_invalid.cancelled-reopened.json: Cancelled Review is frozen and cannot reopen.
application_invalid.active-reviewer-rewritten.json: Active represented reviewer is materially fixed.
application_invalid.active-trigger-rewritten.json: Active initiation semantics are materially fixed.
application_invalid.evidence-removed.json: Active Review evidence may append but not silently remove prior entries.
application_invalid.review-subject-rewritten.json: Records under review are materially fixed after activation.
application_invalid.awaiting-to-open-backward.json: Workflow cannot move backward to open.
application_invalid.updated-at-not-advanced.json: Guarded workflow update must advance updated_at.
